# Two sub-packages parse one package's embed.FS of template fragments. One
# muxt generate at the top writes both, and each serves its page through the
# shared layout.

muxt generate
! stdout .
! stderr .
exec go test ./...

cd workspace
muxt check
cd ../billing
muxt check

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.22
-- muxt.json --
{
	"packages": {
		"example.com/m/workspace": {
			"use_receiver_type": "Server"
		},
		"example.com/m/billing": {
			"use_receiver_type": "Server"
		}
	}
}
-- fragments/fragments.go --
package fragments

import (
	"embed"
	"strings"
)

//go:embed layout.gohtml
var TemplateSource embed.FS

func Upper(s string) string { return strings.ToUpper(s) }
-- fragments/layout.gohtml --
{{define "layout"}}<main data-layout="shared"><h1>{{upper .Title}}</h1>{{.Body}}</main>{{end}}
-- workspace/workspace.go --
package workspace

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"

	"example.com/m/fragments"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateSource embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.Must(template.New("").
	Funcs(template.FuncMap{"upper": fragments.Upper}).
	ParseFS(fragments.TemplateSource, "*.gohtml")).
	ParseFS(templateSource, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}

type Page struct {
	Title string
	Body  string
}

func (Server) Show() Page { return Page{Title: "workspace", Body: "workspace-only text"} }
-- workspace/page.gohtml --
{{define "GET /{$} Show()"}}{{template "layout" .Result}}{{end}}
-- workspace/workspace_test.go --
package workspace

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestShow(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil))

	if got, want := rec.Result().StatusCode, http.StatusOK; got != want {
		t.Errorf("GET / status = %d, want %d", got, want)
	}
	body := rec.Body.String()
	for _, want := range []string{
		`<main data-layout="shared">`, // only the shared layout writes this
		"<h1>WORKSPACE</h1>", // the shared layout calls the shared Upper
		"workspace-only text", // only this package's receiver writes this
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(body, want) {
			t.Errorf("GET / body = %q, want it to contain %q", body, want)
		}
	}
}
-- billing/billing.go --
package billing

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"

	"example.com/m/fragments"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateSource embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.Must(template.New("").
	Funcs(template.FuncMap{"upper": fragments.Upper}).
	ParseFS(fragments.TemplateSource, "*.gohtml")).
	ParseFS(templateSource, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}

type Page struct {
	Title string
	Body  string
}

func (Server) Show() Page { return Page{Title: "billing", Body: "billing-only text"} }
-- billing/page.gohtml --
{{define "GET /{$} Show()"}}{{template "layout" .Result}}{{end}}
-- billing/billing_test.go --
package billing

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestShow(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil))

	if got, want := rec.Result().StatusCode, http.StatusOK; got != want {
		t.Errorf("GET / status = %d, want %d", got, want)
	}
	body := rec.Body.String()
	for _, want := range []string{
		`<main data-layout="shared">`, // only the shared layout writes this
		"<h1>BILLING</h1>", // the shared layout calls the shared Upper
		"billing-only text", // only this package's receiver writes this
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(body, want) {
			t.Errorf("GET / body = %q, want it to contain %q", body, want)
		}
	}
}
